titulo: Yo que tú / si yo fuera tú / yo de ti = if I were you
regla: If I were you: si yo fuera tú, yo que tú, yo de ti, yo en tu lugar, followed by the conditional (llamaría) or perfect conditional (habría llamado / hubiera llamado). They're fixed phrases; don't mix them.

lista.texto: Literal _if I were you_ (imperfect subjunctive of **ser**).
Idiomatic; you'll hear it less in Mexico.

bloques.texto: Then the **conditional** (**llamaría**) or, for the past, the **perfect conditional** (**habría llamado**) or **hubiera** + participle.
Fixed phrases: **yo que tú** and **yo de ti** have no **si**; and it's **que tú** but **de ti**.
Tip: **yo que tú** = put me in your shoes.

lista.es: ==Si yo fuera tú==, llamaría a la policía ahorita mismo.
lista.en: If I were you, I'd call the police right now.

lista.es: ==Si yo fuera tú==, lo habría dejado plantado en el altar.
lista.en: If I were you, I'd have left him at the altar.

lista.es: ==Yo que tú==, me disculparía antes de que sea tarde.
lista.en: If I were you, I'd apologize before it's too late.

lista.es: ==Yo que tú==, le habría dicho la verdad.
lista.en: If I were you, I'd have told him the truth.

lista.es: ==Yo de ti==, hablaría con ellos para aclarar las cosas.
lista.en: If I were you, I'd talk to them to clear things up.

lista.es: ==Yo en tu lugar==, aceptaría esa oferta.
lista.en: In your place, I'd take that offer.

lista.es: ==Yo que tú== hubiera aceptado su oferta.
lista.en: If I were you, I'd have accepted their offer.

filas.t: Si yo que tú, no iría.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish (yo que tú): _If I were you, I'd rest._
In Spanish: _If I were you, I wouldn't have bought it._
lista.r: Si yo fuera tú, no lo habría comprado. / Yo que tú, no lo hubiera comprado.

lista.p: Fix it: _Yo de tú, no le hablaría._
lista.r: Yo de ti, no le hablaría.
